The '''Second Infantry''' was a division in the [[Republic Infantry]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The division was stationed in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="Scrambled Signals" />
